**What shipped:**
- `Server/LayoutCheck.mjs` — class `LayoutCheck` + CLI (`node Server/LayoutCheck.mjs <base> <pages>... [--widths] [--json] [--baseline]`): headless `analyze()` + `PaddingContract.check()` per page×width, BROKEN (high-sev + padding misuse) vs OFF (med/low) counts, top findings, baseline diff for "new BROKEN", browser-context recycling every 40 navs.
- Wired into `Server/merge.mjs` right after the smoke run — report only, exit code ignored, skipped under `--skip-smoke`/`--quick`.

A deliberate scratch-page break (uncommitted, since deleted) reported `BROKEN 1 OFF 1`. Two independent measurements of `/framework/ui/card/` at 1200 agree: LayoutCheck said `BROKEN 1 OFF 11`; a hand-rolled Playwright one-off calling the same two functions directly returned `high:1,med:5,low:6,pad:0` → same numbers. `smoke.mjs` on the worktree exits 0.

**Branch:** `worktree/qf-2`, commits `0cca8ac2b`, `fa3b48f5c`, `24aa74d70`. Not merged.

One thing worth a second look: the BROKEN/OFF split is this task's own definition (DesignTool's rules.js/polish.js tiers aren't separable after roll-up), not an existing site convention — flagged in the task's `complete` evidence for whoever reviews it next.

**Done.** Branch `worktree/qf-6`, commit `11aa9afb6` (worktree at `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-6`, not merged).

**A — six card variants** in `ui/card/page.js`: `titled`, `stack`, `tree-rows`, `compact` (renamed from `list`, same function), `large` (reuses the top specimen), `fit`. No new CSS class — `.flush-stack` (needed for `stack`) didn't actually exist in `framework.css` yet despite the brief's assumption; I moved it there from `ux/Inbox/Inbox.css` (its only prior home, `@layer theme` → `@layer util`, so nothing broke) rather than load an unrelated stylesheet. `fit` reuses `.measure.start` with `--measure: 22em`.

**B — arrow keys** in `Library.js` (`on_keydown`): Left/Right step the siblings rail, Up/Down step the variants rail, both via the same `this.go()` a click uses, ignored while typing. Key test from `?at=ui/card`: ArrowDown → `?at=ui/card/linked`, ArrowDown again → unchanged (expected: `linked` is a leaf with no variants of its own), ArrowRight → `?at=ui/card/media`. Confirmed separately that a keydown targeting a real `<input>` is ignored.

## Step 4 report: the kit as a tree, from H1 up

**Branch:** `worktree/qf-2`, commits `56f56de3b` (A–C) and `3d1465324` (D).

- **A** — new [ui/text](/framework/ui/text/) (`page.js` + `readme.md`): `h1`–`h4`, `p`, `li`, `link`, `flow`, no page CSS. Linked to/from `styles/elements/text/` (the CSS-layer reference this page deliberately doesn't duplicate).
- **B** — `ui/page.js` `BANDS` regrouped to the owner's tree: Elements(5) · Parts(6) · Cards(6) · Menus(6) · Data(4). `item`/`icon`/`datagrid`/`row` moved from the old appended list into real bands; `words` moved out (it's a config-word demo, not a tree component). `ui/readme.md` updated to match.
- **C** — `framework.css`'s flow rules: found and fixed a real rule-order collision (`PageCard.View` renders `"part-card card flow"`, so its own rhythm was caught by both `.card`'s and `.flow`'s `> * + *` rules, with `.flow` winning by accident). Card-internal gap now `14px` (was `28px`). Couldn't reproduce the reported ~7px squeeze on a bare h2-after-card in isolation (measured `63px` both before and after, consistent for h2 anywhere) — logged for the mastermind to re-check against the original `/live/session/` finding.
- **D** — `BROKEN 29 → 0` on `/framework/library/?at=ui/card` at 400px: added `.library-thumb` to `ext/DesignTool/probe.js`'s existing `IGNORE` list (same mechanism as `.page-preview-thumb`). No test added to `LayoutCheck.test.mjs` (it never reaches probe.js); verified live instead.
- **Shots:** `step-4/shots/text-flow-400.png`, `text-flow-1200.png`, `library-wall-1920.png` (in the MAIN tree's task folder).
- **Smoke:** clean except pre-existing, unrelated `**/shots/` 404s (gitignored images, confirmed 200 on compliance/dev).
